requirementResults.reason: The assistant claimed definite success by stating 'I have transmitted your contact details and criteria to the EstatePro team' when the actual handoff outcome was unknown, violating the requirement to explain that the outcome is uncertain.
The assistant did not make any false claims about the visitor being contacted or scheduled.
